A note from our imaginary studio

Small books.
Big feelings.

We believe a book can be a tiny door to a much bigger world. Paper Moon is an imagined independent publisher celebrating stories with heart, art with character, and the magic of reading together.

For the gigglers, the question-askers, the cloud-watchers, and the just-one-more-page-please people.

What we believe

Wonder first ✳

Stories that leave room for children to ask, imagine, and make the ending their own.

Made to be shared ☺

For lap-sized adventures, big feelings, and the lovely ritual of reading aloud.

A world of ways to be ✦

Because every little reader deserves to find possibility between the pages.

There is always room for one more story

Let the wonder
begin.

Find a favorite, settle in, and see where the page takes you.
